sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your style with this premium blue diamond-pattern enamel kada. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure long-lasting brilliance. This chic geometric statement piece is designed to maintain its luxurious luster, making it perfect for everyday fashion-forward wear.
